subject.invitation: You've been invited to join an organization

footer.ignore_notice: If you didn't request this email, you can safely ignore it.

verify_email.title: Verify your email
verify_email.body: Thanks for signing up for ForgeSaaS. Confirm your email address to activate your account.
verify_email.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:

change_email.title: Confirm your new email address
change_email.body: You (or someone with access to your ForgeSaaS account) requested to change your account email to this address. Confirm below to complete the change.
change_email.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:
change_email.expires: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your account email hasn't been changed.

password_reset.title: Reset your password
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your ForgeSaaS password. Click below to choose a new one.
password_reset.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:
password_reset.expires: This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't request a password reset, your account is still safe — just ignore this email.

magic_link.title: Your sign-in link
magic_link.body: Click below to sign in to ForgeSaaS. No password needed.
magic_link.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:
magic_link.expires: This link expires in 15 minutes and can only be used once.

invitation.title: You're invited
invitation.body_with_inviter: {inviter_name} has invited you to join {org_name} on ForgeSaaS.
invitation.body_without_inviter: You've been invited to join {org_name} on ForgeSaaS.
invitation.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:

welcome.title: Welcome to ForgeSaaS
welcome.body: Your email is verified and your ForgeSaaS account is ready to go.

download_link.title: Your data export is ready
download_link.body: The data export you requested is ready to download.
download_link.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:

payment_failed.title: Payment failed
payment_failed.body: We couldn't charge your card for {org_name}'s subscription ({amount}). Update your payment method to avoid losing access.

subscription_expiring.title: Your subscription is expiring
subscription_expiring.body: {org_name}'s {plan_name} plan expires on {expires_at}. Renew now to keep uninterrupted access.

subscription_suspended.title: Your subscription has been suspended
subscription_suspended.body: {org_name}'s {plan_name} plan has been suspended due to a failed payment. Update your payment method to restore access.

trial_ending.title: Your trial is ending soon
trial_ending.body: {org_name}'s trial ends on {trial_end_date}. Upgrade now so your members keep their access.

trial_expired.title: Your trial has ended
trial_expired.body: {org_name}'s trial has ended and no payment method is on file, so access has been paused. Add a payment method to pick up right where you left off.

security_notification.title: Security alert

events.totp_enabled: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your account.
events.totp_disabled: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your account.
events.oauth_linked: Your account was linked to sign in with {provider}.
events.webauthn_registered: A new security key was registered on your account.
events.webauthn_removed: A security key was removed from your account.
events.totp_replay_rejected: A two-factor code that had already been used was rejected on your account. If this wasn't you, someone may have intercepted a code of yours.
events.email_change_requested: A request was made to change your account email to {new_email}. If this was you, no action is needed — just click the confirmation link we sent to the new address. If it wasn't, use the button below to cancel the request before it's confirmed.
events.email_changed: Your account email address was changed to {new_email}.
events.email_change_cancelled: A pending request to change your account email to {new_email} was cancelled. Your account email is unchanged.
events.totp_disabled_by_admin: An administrator disabled two-factor authentication on your account as part of an account-recovery request. If you didn't request this, contact support immediately.

security_notification.footer: If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately and review your active sessions.
